KIDS’ WALLPAPER

Deewar (दीवार)

Deewar means wall — and this design treats the whole wall as one rhythmic composition of interlocking leaf and petal forms, wavy checkerboards and curved bands in teal, turquoise, cobalt, red, yellow, black and white. The character is bold and graphic, somewhere between mid-century collage and Indian street art. Density is high and the energy continuous, with no single focal subject — so it crops confidently to any proportion and loses nothing behind furniture. A strong choice for kids' and teen rooms, playrooms, home offices and energetic commercial spaces like cafés and studios. Premium Non-Woven keeps every edge of the geometry sharp.
